IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Nixon, Jarrett, Schindler, Skinner, Woods, Upthegrove, Armstrong and Condotta

Bill.BriefDescription: Prescribing license fees for small trailers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to small trailer fees; reenacting and amending RCW46.16.0621; adding a new section to chapter 46.16 RCW; and creating anew section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.16.0621 and 2003 c 1 s 2 and 2002 c 352 s 7 areeach reenacted and amended to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) License tab fees are required to be $30 per year for motorvehicles, regardless of year, value, make, or model. (2) For the purposes of this section, "license tab fees" aredefined as the general fees paid annually for licensing motor vehiclesand trailers as defined in RCW 46.04.620 and 46.04.623, including cars,sport utility vehicles, motorcycles, and motor homes. Trailerslicensed under RCW 46.16.068 or 46.16.085 or as provided for in section2 of this act and campers licensed under RCW 46.16.505 are not requiredto pay license tab fees under this section.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText:
(1) In lieu of the fees provided in RCW 46.16.0621, trailers of p. 1 HB 1367less than one thousand five hundred pounds scale weight and used fornoncommercial, personal use on the public highways may be licensed uponthe payment of a license fee according to the following weightschedule:
Under 200 poundsno fee
200 499 pounds$5.00
500 999 pounds$10.00
1000 1499 pounds$20.00
This act applies to registrations that aredue or will become due September 1, 2005, and thereafter.
